subject.title: [Bug]: Teams streaming delivers normal-length replies twice in 2026.5.28

question: Should this issue remain the canonical live-proof tracker for Microsoft Teams stream-final preview/final duplicate rendering?
rationale: Source inspection shows the normal block-fallback path is suppressed, but both the reporter and the related draft PR point to a live Teams SDK/client collapse failure that cannot be settled by mocked unit tests.

options.title: Keep as live Teams proof tracker
options.body: Use this issue for maintainer-led current-release Teams reproduction and root-cause selection before any automated fix is queued.

options.title: Merge into long-reply tracker
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91723 as canonical only if live proof shows normal-length replies now collapse and only over-4000-character replies remain broken.

options.title: Close after live fixed proof
options.body: Close as implemented only after current stable live Teams proof shows normal-length streamed replies render as one visible message.

recommendation.title: Keep as live Teams proof tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for maintainer-led current-release Teams reproduction and root-cause selection before any automated fix is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the SDK rebase and has adjacent current delivery-area commits, so he is the best routing owner for the proof/closure decision.
